item.title: REBUS 002: mechanistic changes, no demonstrated improvement
item.description:
First published in this changelog: 2026-11-14. Archival record date: 2026-11-13 (not a release timestamp). The recorded experiment found internal changes and some changed decisions, not demonstrated improvement. The primary segment reports NO_MEANINGFUL_DIFFERENCE; the replication segment reports INCONCLUSIVE. Both report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for performance. Reused historical windows and a replication segment not independent of circuit choice limit inference; original results remain caveated by historical data-quality limitations. This offline experiment is not a production release.

item.title: REBUS 001: internal change without changed decisions
item.description:
First published in this changelog: 2026-11-14. Archival record date: 2026-11-13 (not a release timestamp). The recorded held-out experiment changed internal state but not matched decisions. Its overall verdict is NO_MEANINGFUL_DIFFERENCE, with INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for performance. This is a bounded negative result on one recorded stream, not proof that perturbation cannot work elsewhere. Original results remain caveated by historical data-quality limitations. This offline experiment is not a production release.

item.title: Official AlphaMorph thesis
item.description:
First published in this changelog: 2026-11-14. Archival record date: 2026-11-11 (not a release timestamp). The public thesis sets out the research rationale, illustrated explanations and evidence boundaries. It distinguishes implemented mechanisms from proposed capabilities and does not establish profitable autonomous operation. This entry records the document, not a backend release.
